newsitem.title: USA: LabOne completes acquisition of Gib Labs.
newsitem.headline: LabOne completes acquisition of Gib Labs.

text.p: LabOne Inc said Monday it has completed acquisition of Gib Laboratories Inc, a New Providence, N.J.-based provider of risk assessment testing.
Gib Laboratories is a subsidiary of Prudential Insurance Co of America.
As previously disclosed, Prudential's Individual Insurance Group has agreed to use LabOne as its exclusive provider of risk assessment testing services.
Revenue under both agreements began Janury 30, 1997.
LabOne operates a centralized laboratory in the Kansas City area which markets clinical, substance abuse and insurance laboratory testing services in the United States and Canada.
